laws.title: Lead-based paint disclosure for pre-1978 housing
laws.summary: Before a tenant signs a lease for housing built before 1978, the landlord must disclose any known lead-based paint or hazards and available records, give the EPA pamphlet 'Protect Your Family From Lead in Your Home', and include a lead warning statement in the lease. The landlord keeps signed disclosure records for 3 years.
